name: Silvia Puglisi
biography: Silvia Puglisi is a Systems Engineer and Privacy Researcher based in Barcelona, EU. She currently leads the network health team at the Tor Project, focusing on maintaining the stability, performance, and security of the Tor network. Silvia is also an O'Reilly author and previously worked at Google for several years. She was part of the Information Security Group at the Department of Telematics Engineering, Universitat Politècnica de Catalunya (UPC), where she earned her Ph.D. Additionally, she has served as an adjunct professor at the Universitat Oberta de Catalunya (UOC).
